replay.note: the advocates' outputs were replayed from an earlier run and not regenerated by this one: only the judge was called, so the figures here measure the judge's behaviour on fixed inputs and not the whole pipeline

ruling.explanation:
Both parties are substantially agreed, and the tribunal finds as follows.

THE DEVIATION IS ESTABLISHED BUT NOT MATERIAL. Measured as POL-RD-01 requires, on the governing trace figure (EV-GPS-00106, trace_distance_km = 10.78 km) against the booked optimal on EV-TRIP-00106 (7.2 km), the excess is 3.58 km, or 49.72% of optimal. That clears the establishment gate (over 20% and over 0.8 km absolute), so a deviation exists. It does not clear the materiality gate (over 50% of optimal, or over 8.0 km absolute): 49.72% and 3.58 km are both under. The trip_record's rounded 10.8 km, which reads as exactly 50.0%, is a convenience copy and, as POL-RD-01 states, may not be cited for this threshold; the finding rests on the trace figure as both advocates urged.

NO EXCULPATORY CLAUSE APPLIES. (i) No traffic advisory: EV-ADVIS-00106-01 sits in the pool as a MISSING artifact with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT. Its absence is citable, and it means POL-RD-03 cannot run, because that clause requires an advisory naming a road the optimal route traverses; the closure cap and closure-adjusted optimal are therefore unavailable to the driver. (ii) No rider-requested detour: the only chat message (EV-CHAT-00106, sent 08:46:30, rider: 'why we at havelock? bugis is behind us') was sent after the vehicle had already left the corridor, carries waypoint_hint null and names no road; under POL-RD-04 the corroboration test is undecidable on this record, the clause is unavailable, and the tribunal says so. (iii) POL-RD-05 does not run: no pickup or dropoff amendment, and amended_optimal_distance_km is null, so there is no amended optimal to apply. (iv) POL-RD-12 does not run: vehicle_type is RYDE_TAXI, not RYDE_POOL, and solo_optimal_distance_km is null. (v) The fare is METERED, so POL-RD-11 does not displace POL-RD-02.

THE REFUND IS ARITHMETIC (POL-RD-02). Surge multiplier 1.0 is read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier on EV-FARE-00106. Charged_total: 26.04. Recomputed_fare: (3.80 + 0.75 x 7.2 + 0.28 x 19.0) x 1.0 + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 ERP on the optimal route = 15.32. Refund: 26.04 - 15.32 = 10.72, rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05 = 10.75. This is above the 0.50 de minimis and well under 90% of charged_total, so the outcome is a PARTIAL_REFUND.

ERP. The two charged gantries (CTE Braddell Rd 3.00; CTE Chin Swee tunnel 2.50) are itemised here for transparency but are already comprehended in the 10.75, because the POL-RD-02 recomputation credits only on-optimal-route gantries and the optimal route carries 0.00. POL-RD-09(1) forbids adding the 5.50 on top; the rider's advocate correctly asks for 10.75, not 16.25.

NO REFERRAL AND NO ESCALATION. No driver pattern is established (driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 96), and the deviation is not material, so no POL-RD-06(b) uplift and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral arises. Both ERP gantries lie on the route actually driven, so no line is unmatched and no POL-RD-09(4) billing-integrity referral arises. No POL-RD-10 trigger fires: the trace is unbroken (169 fixes, 0.0 s max gap, 10 s interval, no POL-RD-07(a)-(c) impairment), trip id TRP-00106 and the 08:35:15 start match across trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown, timestamps do not run backwards, and the refund is within limits.

OUTCOME, party-relative: the rider filed this dispute and currently holds the full 26.04 charge. The charge stands to the extent of the recomputed fare of 15.32, and SGD 10.75 is returned to the rider.
